cleaning_rules_justification.duplicate_spam_texts: 1,273 exact duplicate review texts represent copy-pasted user spam across multiple locations and cause train/test leakage; dropped.
cleaning_rules_justification.ultra_short_or_empty_texts_dropped: Reviews shorter than 10 characters (e.g. 'ok', 'good', '.') lack lexical signal for TF-IDF modeling; dropped.
cleaning_rules_justification.business_missing_categories_imputed: 103 businesses in official Yelp dataset have null categories; imputed as 'Uncategorized' to preserve foreign key joins.
cleaning_rules_justification.business_city_normalization: Standardized inconsistent city naming variants (e.g., 'St. Louis' vs 'Saint Louis', trailing whitespace).
cleaning_rules_justification.extreme_useful_outliers_capped: Viral reviews with >100 useful votes (up to 539) skew linear mean aggregations; winsorized at 100.
